title: Remote Talent Data Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

Key responsibilities:

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

Requirements:

- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.
  • Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.
  • Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.

Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing a solution for a big retail company. The main focus is to support processing of big data volumes and integrate solution to current architecture.

Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong, recent hands-on expertise with Azure Data Factory and Synapse is a must (3+ years).

• Experience in leading a distributed team.

• Strong expertise in designing and implementing data models, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, to support efficient data storage and retrieval.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, pySpark for building scalable and reliable data solutions.

• Extensive experience with building robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data lakes or data warehouses.

• Ability to integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, using appropriate techniques such as API integration or message queuing.

• Proficiency in designing and implementing data warehousing solutions (dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Mesh, Data/Delta Lakehouse, Data Vault)

• Proficiency in SQL to perform complex queries, data transformations, and performance tuning on cloud-based data storages.

• Experience integrating metadata and governance processes into cloud-based data platforms

• Certification in Azure, Databricks, or other relevant technologies is an added advantage

• Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.

• Experience with Azure MI, Azure Database for Postgres, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Analysis Services, and Informix.

• Experience with Python and Python-based ETL tools.

• Experience with shell scripting in Bash, Unix or windows shell is preferable.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Experience with Elasticsearch

• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Troubleshooting and Performance Tuning: Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in data processing workflows and optimize data pipelines for efficient data ingestion and analysis.

• Collaboration and Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with stakeholders, data engineers, data scientists, and other cross-functional teams.

Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros.   • Conduzir projetos de ciência de dados, definindo a abordagem metodológica, garantindo a qualidade das entregas e mentorando cientistas de dados de níveis júnior e pleno.
  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e de Machine Learning.

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros times para garantir a integração e a implantação eficaz das soluções de IA.

Qualificações Essenciais:

  • Áreas de formação: Ciência da computação, Análise e desenvolvimento de sistemas, áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência profissional mínimo de 5 anos de carreira, com pelo menos 3 anos atuando como Cientista de Dados
  • Proficiência em Python e suas bibliotecas de data science
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de Deep Learning (ex: TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Profundo conhecimento em fundamentos de estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clusterização, etc.).
  • Experiência em comunicar e apresentar insights complexos para públicos diversos.
  • Experiência Prática com Grandes Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs)
  • Familiaridade com o Ecossistema de GenAI: Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas que orquestram e aceleram o desenvolvimento de aplicações com LLMs e vector databases.

Diferenciais que nos farão brilhar os olhos:

  • Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com plataformas de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), utilizando serviços como SageMaker, Azure ML ou Vertex AI.
  • Vivência com práticas de MLOps (CI/CD para modelos, monitoramento, versionamento com ferramentas como MLflow ou DVC).
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria ou em projetos para diferentes indústrias.

description:
Business Introduction

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

We provide industrial procurement solutions to more than 7,000 large customers and more than 8 million small and medium-sized business customers. We work with more than 30,000 suppliers of industrial goods, and our platform has more than 40 million SKUs .

Now JD Industrials focuses on developing overseas business, providing one-stop industrial product procurement solutions for enterprises from different countries. Our business has spread to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America .

title: Analista tributário sênior
description:
We Are PepsiCo

Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

PepsiCo Brasil: In Brazil since 1953, PepsiCo has well-known brands such as QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI®, among others.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world.

Know more: PepsiCoJobs

Join PepsiCo, dare for better.

The Opportunity

Serve as a technical reference in the tax area, focusing on compliance, tax planning, and strategic support to leadership. Ensure adherence to current legislation while identifying opportunities for tax efficiency.

Your Impact

This position is responsible for strategic tax planning analyses across all Brazilian legal entities within the group (PdB, PBI, PABB, Pepsicola), with a focus on anticipating tax impacts, identifying efficiency opportunities, and ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

1. Respond to tax-related inquiries from business areas, providing clear and accurate guidance aligned with current legislation.

2. Define and communicate tax rules applicable to all new company operations, ensuring proper implementation and compliance.

3. Periodically review and update existing tax rules used across the organization to reflect legislative changes and business needs.

4. Support the tax manager in delivering training sessions to business teams, aiming to raise awareness and mitigate tax-related risks.

5. Collaborate with the tax legal team on strategic analyses and technical assessments to identify opportunities for tax efficiency and risk reduction.

6. Provide tax support for innovation projects under evaluation by the Marketing team, including taxation analysis for new products.

7. Assist in the review of commercial and operational contracts from a tax perspective.

8. Maintain updated reports and dashboards for the tax manager, ensuring visibility of key metrics and ongoing initiatives.

9. Act as a key partner to the business in the implementation of the Brazilian tax reform, supporting impact assessments, process adjustments, and the transition to the new tax framework

Who Are We Looking For?

  • Solid understanding of tax legislation; Understanding of tax accounting, including bookkeeping, calculation of taxes and contributions and development of tax returns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law (with OAB) or Accounting (with CRC). A degree in Business Administration with an MBA in Tax Management is also acceptable.
  • Experience in the tax area, with a background in compliance, planning, and strategic projects.
  • Solid knowledge of federal and state taxes, ancillary obligations, tax law, direct taxes, and corporate tax.
  • Intermediate to advanced English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; experience with SAP and Mastersaf is a plus.
  • Good negotiation and communication skills (oral and written). Proactiveness. Resilience. Strategic thinking.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us:

• Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.

• Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning.

• Development programs according to Leadership skills.

• Specialized training according to the role.

• Learning experiences with internal and external providers.

• We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.

• Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.

• A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.

• And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

  • Modelar dados em camadas intermediárias e analíticas (Bronze, Silver e Gold) no Databricks , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e governança.

title: Portuguese/English Financial Research (Relocation to Chile)
description:
This position requires relocation to Viña del Mar, Chile, and operates in a hybrid work mode. We welcome applications from candidates based in any country.

Elevate Your Impact Through Innovation and Learning

Evalueserve is a global leader in delivering innovative and sustainable solutions to a diverse range of clients, including over 30% of Fortune 500 companies.

With presence in more than 45 countries across five continents, we excel in leveraging state-of-the-art technology, artificial intelligence, and unparalleled subject matter expertise to elevate our clients' business impact and strategic decision-making.

We have 4,500+ talented professionals operating across 45 countries, including India, China, Chile, Romania, the US, and Canada. Our global network also extends to emerging markets such as Colombia, the Middle East, and the rest of Asia-Pacific.

Recognized by Great Place to Work® in India, Chile, Romania, the US, and the UK in 2022, we offer a dynamic, growth-oriented, and open culture that prioritizes flexible work-life balance, diverse and inclusive teams, and equal opportunities for all.

Curious to know what it’s like to work at Evalueserve?

Watch this .

About Corporate and Investment Banking & Investment Research (CIB & IR)

As a global leader in knowledge processes, research, and analytics, you’ll be working with a team that specializes in global market research, working with the top-rated investment research organizations, bulge bracket investment banks, and leading asset managers. We cater to 8 of the top 10 global banks, working alongside their product and sector teams, supporting them on deal origination, execution, valuation, and transaction advisory-related projects.

Click here to know more.

What you will be doing at Evalueserve

  • Preparation of information memoranda, company profiles (one-pagers and deep dive), Industry overviews, management presentations, deal tombstones, pitchbooks, due diligence decks and financial models.
  • Maintaining trading and transaction comps.
  • Creating and maintaining industry databases, newsletters and market updates.
  • Collecting financial data using on-line and other data sources such as Factset, Capital IQ, EIKON, Bloomberg, etc.
  • Handling ad hoc research requests such as competitor benchmarking, target screening, capital structure and liquidity analysis, as per client requirements.

What we’re looking for

  • Graduate degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or related areas.
  • Experience of 0 – 4 years in finance or related area.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-based multicultural environment.
  • Strong communication is a must for interaction with Americas/Europe based clients and with other centers of Evalueserve.
  • Attention to details and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Portuguese is a must.
  • Spanish is a plus, but not mandatory.
  • Flexibility to work as per client schedule and workload requirements.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) is a must.

title: Operador de Utilidades
description:
Sobre a Chlorum Solutions

Na Chlorum, inovamos a forma de produzir e entregar cloro-álcalis e derivados. Há 10 anos, somos pioneiros em um modelo descentralizado de produção, baseado em miniplantas instaladas próximas – ou até dentro – das operações dos nossos clientes.

Com isso, eliminamos a necessidade de longos deslocamentos, aumentamos a segurança e garantimos mais eficiência logística e continuidade no fornecimento. Nossa solução é ambientalmente sustentável, segura e eficiente, transformando a cadeia tradicional da indústria química com mais proximidade e impacto positivo.

Nossa Cultura

Nós acreditamos nas pessoas e no seu potencial de desenvolvimento. Somos guiados pelo nosso jeito único de ser: valorizamos a agilidade, senso de dono e visão de longo prazo para fazer a diferença. Esses são os pilares que sustentam nossa cultura colaborativa que nos impulsiona.

Sobre a Oportunidade – Operador(a) de Utilidades

Como Operador(a) de Utilidades, você será responsável por garantir a operação contínua e segura dos sistemas de utilidades, como caldeiras, compressores, torres de resfriamento, bombas e sistemas de tratamento de água.

Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Realizar inspeções periódicas nos equipamentos de utilidades, utilizando checklists e análises visuais para identificar desgastes, vazamentos ou necessidades de manutenção;
  • Operar sistemas de tratamento de água por meio de análises químicas e físicas, assegurando a qualidade e potabilidade da água;
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas, pequenos reparos e registrar todas as atividades em planilhas e sistemas de gestão;
  • Identificar e relatar anomalias, falhas e ocorrências, comunicando-se com a equipe de manutenção para rápida resolução;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e treinamentos à equipe operacional, promovendo a segurança e o correto manuseio dos equipamentos;
  • Cumprir as normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade, participando ativamente dos programas de prevenção de riscos.

Requisitos e qualificações que esperamos que você tenha

  • Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório);
  • Formação técnica em áreas relacionadas (obrigatório);
  • Experiência de 1 a 2 anos em operação de utilidades industriais;
  • Curso de Operador de Caldeiras e/ou Compressores com certificado válido;
  • Conhecimentos em normas de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente;
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de diagramas, esquemas e manuais técnicos;
  • Conhecimento básico em informática e sistemas computacionais para acompanhamento de processos;

Nossos benefícios

  • Day off de aniversário
  • Cartão Flexível
  • Vale Transporte

  • Plano de Saúde

title: Consultor de Mídia
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Fidelizar os clientes atuais e prospectar novos, apresentando a Iguatemi, seus shoppings e oportunidades comerciais, a fim de trazer receita e 100% de ocupação para o shopping sob sua gestão;

Comercializar propriedades como locações temporárias, mídia, merchandising, eventos, patrocínios e demais que englobam o Planejamento Comercial Anual (PAC) do shopping sob sua responsabilidade;

Ter controle rigoroso sobre o fluxo de faturamento dos contratos do shopping, garantindo a menor inadimplência possível;

Manter o fluxo direto da informação/comunicação das suas atividades junto à gerência comercial regional, para garantir alinhamento de informações no mercado, evitando a sobreposição de negociações;

Visitar a concorrência local/regional, pesquisar oportundiades de negócio nos ambientes digitias (Instagram, LinkedIn, sites de varejo, etc) relevantes a sua unidade a fim de identificar clientes potenciais e se manter atualizado quanto às novidades do mercado;

Responsável por atualizar e acompanhar diariamente o placar dos seus índices de performance, resultados, pipeline de vendas, vacância, detectando necessidades de planos de ação para atingimento de metas e maximização do potencial de vendas de propriedades;

Realizar reuniões quinzenais junto à gerência geral, Marketing e Operações do seu shopping visando otimizar oportunidades de projetos que possam ser comercializados e alinhar negócios em andamento;

Participar de pelo menos uma reunião semanalmente com os demais gestores da unidade de atuação (Matinal) e participar semanalmente da Reunião Comercial-Operacional (RECOP);

Preparar materiais e apresentações para a diretoria e outras áreas conforme demanda;

Gerenciar todo processo de negociação em conjunto com jurídico, shopping e lojista para garantir a efetivação dos contratos nos prazos estabelecidos;

Garantir o monitoramento de todas as etapas pós-negociação, documentação, SISCOM (se houver), assinatura e entrega da propriedade;

Dar suporte aos seus clientes em todo o contato com o shopping, desde aprovação de projetos, layouts, autorizações de entrada, assinatura de contrato, quitação de boleto, etc;

No caso de shoppings com assistente, fazer a gestão do assistente e sua rotina, com foco em retenção e desenvolvimento de carreira dentro da empresa;

Realizar todas as atividades em conformidade com as normas da empresa e ao Programa de Excelência Iguatemi (PEXI).

title: Estagiário(a) de Gastronomia
description:
Venha viver nosso propósito!

Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de "cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor".

Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores.

· Ser íntegro nos torna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho;

· Somos empáticos pois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade;

· Buscamos a todo instante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo;

· Prezamos por um ambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência!

title: Analista de Controladoria SR
description:
Descrição da Empresa:

O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.

Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.

Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. ❤️

Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!

Sobre a área:

A área de Controladoria é responsável por garantir a integridade das informações financeiras e gerenciais, apoiando a tomada de decisão estratégica. Os principais objetivos incluem aprimorar os processos contábeis dentro das normas e melhorar os controles, aumentar a acuracidade das projeções financeiras, garantir a veracidade dos dados e promover maior integração entre áreas.

Principais atividades:

  • Consolidação de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Realizar a consolidação contábil das empresas do grupo, assegurando a correta eliminação de saldos intercompany e a conformidade com as normas contábeis (CPCs/IFRS);
  • Fechamento contábil mensal e anual: Coordenar e executar os processos de fechamento contábil, garantindo a acuracidade das informações e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos pela controladora;
  • Elaboração e revisão de demonstrações financeiras: Preparar e revisar BP, DRE, DFC e suporte para as notas explicativas, com foco em transparência e conformidade com as exigências da CVM e auditoria externa;
  • Gestão de processos intercompany: Controlar e conciliar transações entre empresas do grupo, assegurando que estejam devidamente registradas e eliminadas na consolidação;
  • Análise de contas contábeis e conciliações: Realizar análises críticas de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, assegurando que os saldos estejam corretos e justificados;
  • Suporte a projetos estratégicos e de pós M&A: Participar de projetos de fusões, aquisições ou reestruturações societárias, contribuindo com análises contábeis e suporte técnico;
  • Automatização e melhoria de processos contábeis: Identificar oportunidades de automação e eficiência nos processos contábeis, colaborando com áreas de tecnologia e controladoria;
  • Participar de reuniões com áreas parceiras para alinhamento de metas e resultados;
  • Suporte a equipe com mapeamento dos processos internos adequando de acordo com os interesses da cia e bom andamento dos prazos e entregas.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em contabilidade, controladoria, planejamento financeiro e análise de resultados;
  • Domínio intermediário de Excel e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, VBA, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em ERP (preferencialmente TOTVS / DATASUL);

title: Master/PHD in Legal
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.

Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.

Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  1. Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:
  1. Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify

Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  1. Arabic Language test

Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.

If interested, kindly share your resume at:

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

Job Description

This professional will be part of the Process Innovation Team, that plays a transformative role in defining and deploying Samsung's Logistics Strategy for Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami) for Finished Goods (all product lines) and Spare Parts operations. Key programs to be supported by this position include:

  • Long-Term Capacity Planning: Process Implementation and improvement, Logistics Network Design, Warehouse Infrastructure (including automation projects), Transportation Modes, etc.
  • Cost Efficiency Program: Lead analysis to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings (productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation, warehouse storage efficiency, lead time reductions, LSP management, etc.).
  • Process Innovation: Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that support logistics operations optimization and better governance in Latin America (planning, control, analysis).

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Analyze processes and related data to support the definition and deployment Samsung’s logistics strategy for Latin America, covering Finished Goods and Spare Parts operations across key markets (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami).
  • Run sales demand and logistics capacity analysis to support “Long Term Capacity Planning” program, that involves logistics network design, warehouse infrastructure (including automation projects), and transportation modes.
  • Lead and/or support analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings, such as:
  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.
  • Warehouse storage efficiency enhancements.
  • Lead time reductions.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.
  • Focus on areas such as planning, control, and analysis to support logistics optimization.
  • Work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to gather information and carry on the necessary analysis of logistics operations process and performance across Latin America.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, IT, and other departments to drive efficiency and innovation.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to address concerns, implement solutions, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate logistics performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare detailed reports on logistics operations, cost-saving initiatives, and process innovations for senior management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to enhance logistics processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.
  • Ability to prepare detailed analysis, graphics and reports to support and/or make presentations senior management.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, internal and external partners.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency. Power BI is a Plus.
  • Fluent in English (mandatory).
  • Spanish proficiency (desirable).

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

title: Especialista Clinico
description:
3M Health Care agora é Solventum

Na Solventum, possibilitamos cuidados de saúde melhores, mais inteligentes e mais seguros para melhorar vidas. Como uma nova empresa com um longo legado na criação de soluções inovadoras para os desafios mais difíceis dos nossos clientes, somos pioneiros em inovações revolucionárias na interseção da saúde, dos materiais e da ciência de dados que mudam a vida dos pacientes para melhor, ao mesmo tempo que permitem aos profissionais de saúde atuar em o melhor deles. Porque as pessoas e o seu bem-estar estão no centro de cada avanço científico que buscamos.

Estabelecemos parcerias estreitas com as mentes mais brilhantes da área da saúde para garantir que cada solução que criamos combina a tecnologia mais recente com compaixão e empatia. Porque na Solventum nunca paramos de resolver para você.

O impacto que você causará nesta função:

Nesta função você impactará na melhoria das práticas clínicas em Key Accounts atendidos pela Solventum, por meio de ações educacionais e treinamentos para promover a adesão a recomendações, standards e protocolos baseados em evidências e desta forma acelerar a adoção de tecnologias Solventum, alinhado com a estratégia da Divisão Medical Surgical.

Como Especialista Clínico(a) na Solventum, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com profissionais inovadores e diversos, contribuindo diretamente para a transformação de práticas clínicas em instituições hospitalares.

Aqui, você causará impacto ao:

  • Promover melhorias clínicas por meio da apresentação de evidências científicas, programas educacionais e treinamentos técnicos em instituições hospitalares;
  • Realizar apoio técnico e educacional para acelerar o fechamento do ciclo de novas oportunidades de introdução e/ou geração de demanda das tecnologias Solventum para o segmento de Prevenção de Infecção em Sítio Cirúrgico (foco em Preparo da Pele e Normotermia) e Esterilização de Dispositivos Médicos (CME);
  • Utilizar ferramentas de economia da saúde para embasar estratégias de introdução de novas tecnologias nas instituições, agregando valor às decisões clínicas e administrativas;
  • Capacitar equipes internas e da rede de distribuição , garantindo excelência técnica e alinhamento estratégico;
  • Contribuir com insights relevantes para o desenvolvimento de estratégias de negócio e apoiar o lançamento de novos produtos no mercado.

Suas habilidades e conhecimentos

Para prepará-lo para o sucesso nesta função desde o primeiro dia, a Solventum exige (no mínimo) as seguintes qualificações:

  • Bacharelado (concluído e verificado antes do início) em Enfermagem. Especialização em CC e CME.
  • Três (3) anos de experiência clínica em instituições hospitalares na área de Centro Cirúrgico (CC) ou Centro de Material e Esterilização (CME) e/ou Controle de Infecção (CCIH) em Bloco Operatório.
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na construção de protocolos e implementação de boas práticas para Prevenção de ISC (Centro Cirúrgico e CME).
  • Experiência prática como treinador/professor/instrutor.
  • Ótimos conhecimentos no pacote Office (Power Point, Excel, Outlook).
  • Inglês: intermediário para leitura
  • Carteira de habilitação atual e válida.

Qualificações adicionais que podem ajudá-lo a ter ainda mais sucesso nessa função incluem:

  • Pós-graduação em Centro Cirúrgico ou Central de Material e Esterilização ou áreas com afinidade.
  • Experiência com projetos de melhoria de processos, indicadores de qualidade, gerenciamento de riscos e/ou acreditações.
  • Experiência como consultor clínico em indústrias do segmento médico-hospitalar.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

⸻

Core Responsibilities

• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts .

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations , manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.

• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules .

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.

• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders , with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

⸻

Key Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 27 years. We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world.

Today our team has more than 5 000 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies. Together we protect the world from cyber threats.

Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving!

The Technical Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for ensuring MSA premium support customers' satisfaction with Kaspersky's products and services. This role focuses on establishing and maintaining strong working relationships with designated client contacts while ensuring the proper maintenance and effective utilisation of Kaspersky products within enterprise environments. The TAM guarantees swift resolution of technical issues in accordance with service agreements and manages any necessary technical escalations.

These highly skilled technical professionals serve a critical function in supporting our enterprise clientele, collaborating with various internal teams to address and resolve complex technical issues. Their regular responsibilities include conducting in-depth technical analyses, managing critical incident responses, delivering Professional Services, and spearheading both incident prevention initiatives and resolution strategies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage MSA customer requests to ensure timely and efficient issue resolution;
  • Deliver MSA premium support focused on incident resolution and product/service renewal to ensure customer satisfaction;
  • Ensure compliance with contractually documented Maintenance Service Agreements;
  • Conduct regular onsite visits for MSA Enterprise customers to maintain engagement and address issues proactively;
  • Follow all documented processes to maintain organisational visibility of customer issues/requests;
  • Facilitate communication between customers, product experts, and development teams to manage escalations requiring fixes or feature requests;
  • Collaborate with clients to assess their IT business needs, requirements, and challenges;
  • Plan, develop and test technical solutions and architectures meeting client needs;
  • Analyse customer business requirements and diagnose product/system issues through end-user consultation;
  • Advocate for customers regarding required fixes or feature requests;
  • Provide customers with work reports and host review calls for technical/support issues;
  • Deliver consultative knowledge transfer and documentation to clients;
  • Update product documentation and share customer feedback/feature requests with product managers;
  • Deliver Kaspersky Professional Services upon request.

Skills & Qualifications:

Communication

  • Fluent in English (written/spoken); Spanish proficiency is a strong plus;
  • Proven ability to engage senior technical/management stakeholders;
  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.

Technical Expertise

Advanced:

  • Microsoft OS : Windows Server 2019+, Windows 10+ ( Microsoft Certification preferred );
  • Linux Administration : Ubuntu, CentOS;
  • Enterprise Networking : TCP/IP, DNS, Firewall, Active Directory;
  • Virtualisation : VMware ESXi, Hyper-V;
  • Troubleshooting : Wireshark, system logs/dump analysis.

Intermediate:

  • MS SQL & Exchange;
  • Web/messaging systems.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Kaspersky product certifications;
  • CompTIA CASP+ or equivalent.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field;
  • 7+ years in IT (with 4+ years focused on IT security );
  • Certifications : MCP (Windows Server/Windows 10+); CCNA ( highly beneficial ); VMware ESXi/Linux certifications;
  • Must obtain Kaspersky core certifications within 3 months of hire.

Other Competencies

  • Proactive ownership of resolution and root-cause analysis;
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex systems;
  • Critical thinking and decision-making;
  • Excellent time management and prioritisation in fast-paced environments.

Recruitment Process (~3 weeks total):

We value transparency and efficiency, here’s what to expect:

  1. Resume Review.
  2. Introductory Video Call (30 min | Recruiter).
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60 min | Technical/Cultural Fit).
  4. Offer & Reference Check.

title: Seller operation
description:
Seller Operation

Job Title: Seller Operation

Job Descriptions:

1. Merchant Collaboration Development and Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned merchants, building trust through proactive communication.
  • Understand merchant KPIs (GMV targets, AOV, conversion rates) and align agency resources to support goal achievement.
  • Collaborate with merchants to co-develop growth strategies tailored to their brand voice and audience.
  • Manage relationship with Tiktok team and Resolve escalations promptly (e.g., account suspensions, payment delays, policy violations) by liaising with TikTok’s merchant support team and internal stakeholders.

2. Operational Process Management

  • Streamline merchant onboarding and day-to-day operations by documenting SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for account setup, content approval, ad account linking, and performance review.
  • Manage merchant support and ensure timely resolution.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to align merchant needs with agency capabilities.

3. Performance Coaching & Growth Optimization

  • Track and report on key merchant health metrics: GMV, order volume, etc to identify growth bottlenecks and provide solutions to ensure continuous improvement.
  • Provide actionable insights and coaching: train merchants on content best practices, advertising optimization, and product listing improvements.
  • Drive merchant upsell/cross-sell opportunities by leveraging platforms and agency's resources.
  • Build and maintain dashboards to visualize merchant performance trends and flag underperforming accounts periodically.
  • Generate weekly/monthly operational reports for internal leadership, highlighting positive and negative points, challenges, and improvement plans.

4. Market Insights & Feedback Loop

  • Collect and synthesize merchant feedback on platform pain points and share with TikTok’s product/operations teams to influence platform improvements.
  • Monitor industry trends (e.g., emerging content formats, consumer behavior shifts) and share actionable reports with merchants to keep them ahead of competitors.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, E-commerce, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in merchant BD, account management, or e-commerce operations, preferably within TikTok Shop, Amazon, or similar social commerce platforms.
  • Familiar with e-commerce operations workflows.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence merchants and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership with analytical mindset on data-driven decision-making.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced environments; ability to manage multiple priorities (merchants, projects, deadlines).
  • Fluent in English speaking and writing.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
  • Pós-graduação em Arquitetura de Software ou de Soluções
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas é desejável
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend, arquitetura de software e liderança técnica.
  • Histórico de participação em projetos escaláveis e performáticos.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Portfólio técnico relevante (GitHub, projetos ou contribuições open source).

Competências Técnicas

  • Domínio Profundo do Ecossistema Java:
  • Java moderno: Spring Boot e ecossistema (security, data, etc.), Quarkus (desempenho), etc. para injeção de dependências, programação reativa, microsserviços, etc.
  • Java legado: Java EE (JSP, Servlets, EJB), Struts, JSF, etc. para manutenção, convivência, modernização, ,migração e/ou refatoração.
  • JVM e performance: domínio da JVM (garbage collection e tuning).
  • Arquitetura de Software e Design Patterns:
  • Desenho de soluções desacopladas, coesas e de fácil manutenção.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões arquiteturais importantes e justificar suas decisões com base em requisitos técnicos e/ou de negócio.
  • Especialista em padrões de projetos clássicos (GoF: Gang of Four) e para microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Expertise em Back-end e Visão Abrangente de Front-end:
  • Back-end: Java, DB (SQL: Oracle/SQL Sever, e NoSQL), mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ), construção de APIs RESTful robustas e bem documentadas.
  • Front-end: é necessário conhecimento sólido dos fundamentos de front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React e Angular.
  • Cultura de DevOps e Automação:
  • Experiência em CI/CD com GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.
  • Conhecimento de conteinerização com: Kubernetes, Docker, Nexus, etc.
  • Experiência e espírito de testes automatizados: unitários, integração e performance.
  • Qualidade, Segurança e Manutenção:
  • Code review, análise estática e dinâmica de código (SONAR), avaliação de métricas de qualidade do codebase.
  • Mentalidade de “segurança desde a concepção” e no caso de manutenção “a intervenção mínima e segura que resolve o problema”, sem sub ou over engineering.

title: Advanced Process Control Engineer
description:
Dexcent Inc. has an opportunity for a Advanced Process Control Engineer to join our growing team in Fort McMurray, AB. The individual will be required to be on site and to relocate to Canada.

This opportunity is open to candidates both locally and internationally. We are prepared to support relocation for successful candidates, including assistance with visa sponsorship where applicable.

About Dexcent

Founded in 2006, Dexcent Inc. (Dexcent) is an engineering consulting firm that provides a range of specialized solutions for clients in a variety of industries throughout the world. Our professionals have modernized IT and OT engineering methodologies into comprehensive solutions, specializing in information analytics, cyber-security, infrastructure, and control systems engineering. As such, we pride ourselves on truly transforming industrial operations to optimize business performance and deliver bottom-line results.

About the Candidate

Our ideal candidate has the following skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Advanced Process Control (APC) Certification from recognized institutions or organizations offering specialized training in APC technologies and methodologies preferred.
  • 3+ years experience with OSIsoft PI Historian for real-time data acquisition, storage, analysis, and visualization in an industrial or process control environment is required.
  • 5+ years experience with Honeywell Experion PKS, ESVT/EST, Honeywell TPS / TDC3000.
  • Process controllers: C300, C200, HPM, APM.
  • All variety of third-party PLC/devices integration to DCS.
  • Industrial Communication: Modbus RTU & Modbus TCP/IP, Serial Communication RS 485, RS 422, RS 232.
  • Networking Skills: Fault Tolerant Ethernet (FTE), Ethernet.
  • Configure and Administer Windows domain (Experion and TPS Domains).
  • OPC connectivity between Process control servers and other 3rd party servers.
  • MS Excel-macro based tools.
  • Experience configuring, implementing and trouble-shooting process control schemes in Honeywell TDC3000 (basic control algorithms and CL/AM code/PMX(basic control algorithms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Routine monitoring of APCs – this includes troubleshooting of APC related issues, direct communication with Process Engineers and Panel operators to address any issues affecting their ability to keep the APCs online, ensuring the optimization of the APCs are being met and evaluating the performance of soft sensors (inferentials) to ensure they do not drift from laboratory readings.
  • Reporting to relevant stakeholders about the APC performance – this includes a weekly APC report, Monthly Inferential and APC Stewardship reports and Monthly, Quarterly and Year to Date KPIs.
  • Development of new APC solutions and maintenance of existing applications. With the APC team being Regional this maybe at any of our client sites.
  • APC training of Operators and other interested parties.
  • Data Analysis – this is done in Excel or a number of different applications such as SEEQ or Honeywell Suite of products.
  • Support software and hardware upgrade activities that involve APC related equipment.
  • Other related duties as required.

At Dexcent we recognize that people are our most important asset. We appreciate the diverse experience, knowledge, creativity, and personality that each person brings to our organization, our culture, and our success.

If this sounds like the right career opportunity for you, apply today!

title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Commercial Flows)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.

Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools

In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA

As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.

The FPSO team consist into an international team of experiences resources with strong expertise in there domain. They act as the keeper of the Group practices and solutions. They coordinate the different on-going project in the LDC world for their respective scope.

Main Responsibilities

The FPSO team is looking for FPSO Specialist Commercial Flows, who will be in charge of the one or more of the below E2E processes flows:

  • Purchase and Sales of commercial goods
  • Inventory management
  • Transportation flows

The FPSO Specialist Commercial flows:

  • On one side, guarantees the LDC Group practices and processes related to commercial processes
  • On the other side, support countries in their execution but also guarantee efficiency in terms of tools, organisation and processes.

This applies in different kind of activities:

  • Live countries support and small enhancements : enhance user experience, provide continuous improvement, be the core model keeper and supervise the delivery of changes, keep documentation up to date
  • Small projects, called “Ad-Hoc”: launch and drive initiatives to improve BOLD

title: Statistics Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with a Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field to join our cutting-edge AI team. In this role, you will contribute to the development, training, and fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) by applying statistical methods, data analysis, and model evaluation techniques. Your expertise will directly impact the accuracy, performance, and robustness of advanced AI systems deployed for real-world applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement statistical frameworks for the preparation, analysis, and quality assessment of large-scale datasets used in training LLMs.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to detect biases, data inconsistencies, and anomalies in training corpora.
  • Collaborate closely with AI researchers and engineers to develop data annotation guidelines and evaluation protocols.
  • Apply advanced statistical methods to assess model outputs and guide iterative training improvements.
  • Develop and maintain automated tools for data preprocessing, labeling, sampling, and quality control in LLM pipelines.
  • Conduct rigorous hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and performance benchmarking of LLMs across various tasks.
  • Interpret model behaviors using statistical insights and provide actionable recommendations for model fine-tuning.
  • Document methodologies, maintain reproducible workflows, and contribute to technical publications.

Key Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science (with strong statistics focus), or related quantitative field.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, probability theory, and experimental design.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale datasets, data cleaning, feature engineering, and statistical analysis tools.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Job Summary:

The Junior Accounting Analyst will play a key role in the accounting department, assisting with daily accounting activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. This position is ideal for a proactive and detail-oriented individual looking to grow their career in finance. The analyst will be responsible for supporting various accounting functions, including journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop a strong foundation in accounting principles. The Junior Accounting Analyst will report to the Accounting Manager.

Key Job Responsibilities:

1. Journal Entries:

  • Assist in making journal entries in financial and accounting systems, ensuring transactions are correctly classified and recorded.
  • Record routine operations such as payments, receipts, billing, and payroll, among others.

2. Account Reconciliation:

  • Perform bank reconciliations, and reconcile accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Identify and investigate potential discrepancies, and accurately and timely reconcile balances.

3. Account Analysis and Variance Analysis:

  • Analyze accounting accounts, identifying variations, trends, and anomalies in balances.
  • Prepare account analysis reports and explain variances to the accounting team.

4. Financial Reporting:

  • Assist in preparing periodic financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Collect and organize financial data to support management's decision-making.

5. Compliance with Tax and Regulatory Requirements:

  • Assist in preparing the necessary documentation and information to meet tax obligations, including tax returns and ancillary obligations.
  • Stay up-to-date with accounting and tax regulations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and laws.

6. Support for Audits and Closing Processes:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing requested documentation and information accurately and on time.
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close processes, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of accounting records.

Qualifications:

  • Technical or bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Basic knowledge of financial accounting and accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems and the Office suite, especially Excel.
  • Analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication

Gestão e Acompanhamento de Projetos de Inovação Aberta: Gerenciar e acompanhar diretamente projetos piloto e rollout entre grandes empresas (clientes da Innoscience) e startups, assegurando a execução eficiente e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos desde o início até a conclusão. 

Gerenciamento de Relacionamentos: Estabelecer e manter relações produtivas entre as partes interessadas das grandes empresas e startups, agindo como um ponto de ligação para resolver questões e promover uma comunicação clara. 

Monitoramento e Avaliação: Acompanhar o progresso dos projetos piloto e de rollout, utilizando indicadores de desempenho para avaliar os resultados e identificar oportunidades de melhoria. 

Gerenciamento de Riscos e Soluções: Proativamente identificar riscos potenciais nos projetos piloto e rollout e trabalhar em soluções criativas junto ao cliente Innoscience e startups para mitigá-los, garantindo o mínimo de interrupções no progresso do projeto. 

Facilitação da aplicação da Metodologia Innoscience: Implementar e promover a metodologia da Innoscience dentro dos projetos para acelerar a entrega de resultados e adaptar-se rapidamente a novas informações ou mudanças de mercado. 

Condução de Workshops, Rituais e Dinâmicas de Trabalho: Planejar e conduzir workshops e dinâmicas de trabalho para estruturação do trabalho e alinhamento entre as equipes de grandes empresas e startups, promovendo um ambiente de cocriação e pensamento crítico. 

Capacitação e Suporte às Equipes: Fornecer suporte e treinamento contínuo para as equipes envolvidas, assegurando que possuam as habilidades necessárias para executar os projetos piloto com sucesso. 

Gestão de Expectativas: Gerenciar as expectativas de todas as partes interessadas, garantindo alinhamento e satisfação com os resultados dos projetos piloto e de rollout. 

Análise dos Resultados e Compartilhamento de Aprendizados: Suportar os times dos Desafios na análise e captura dos resultados dos experimentos, orientando a estruturação do Business Case e planejamento de rollout, bem como a análise de lições aprendidas e melhores práticas em cada projeto, compartilhando conhecimentos para aprimorar futuros projetos de inovação aberta. 

Promoção da Cultura de Inovação: Contribuir para a criação e manutenção de uma cultura de inovação dentro das organizações participantes, incentivando a experimentação e a adoção de novas ideias e tecnologias. "

Forma de contratação: PJ

Modelo: Híbrido, com atuação presencial no Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Benefícios e Oportunidades na Innoscience:

PLR - Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: Incentivo financeiro baseado no desempenho da empresa e individual, promovendo o alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais.

Plano de Carreira em Y: Oferecemos duas trajetórias de evolução profissional: técnica ou liderança. Nosso plano é baseado em avaliações 360º, feedbacks e acompanhamento do plano de desenvolvimento individual.

Acesso a Tecnologia de IA Generativa: Trabalhe com as mais avançadas tecnologias de inteligência artificial generativa, impulsionando soluções inovadoras para nossos clientes.

Cultura de Alto Desempenho: Ambiente dinâmico e desafiador que valoriza a excelência e a superação de resultados.

Práticas de Gestão de Pessoas: Adotamos práticas de gestão baseadas nas teorias mais avançadas da psicologia organizacional, focadas no desenvolvimento e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores.

title: Sales Operations Specialist
description:
Title: Sales & Operations Lead

Location: Brazil

Employment type: Full-time

About the Role

We are expanding our presence in Brazil and seeking a Sales & Operations Lead to ensure every customer order and shipment runs smoothly, from confirmation to delivery. This is a hands-on role where you will own the order-to-cash cycle, drive continuous improvements, and act as the connector between Sales, Finance, Logistics partners, and customers.

This is an exciting chance to join a fast-growing, international organization where your work directly impacts growth and customer success.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage inbound & outbound logistics , ensuring on-time and in-full delivery.
  • Own the order-to-cash cycle : processing orders, maintaining accurate records, and overseeing invoicing.
  • Align demand, supply, and inventory with sales forecasts.
  • Serve as the daily link between Sales, Finance (external back-office), logistics partners, and customers.
  • Support billing, collections, and proactive customer communications.

  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English.

What We Offer

  • A chance to be a key player in building our Brazilian operations.
  • The autonomy and responsibility of a lean, fast-paced team.
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities in a future-proof industry.

title: Remote Physics Expert (PhD) - 34878
description:
Join Turing as a Physics Expert (PhD, Remote) and help shape how the world’s most advanced AI models reason about physics. Work on cutting-edge projects with top AI labs while earning upto $150/hr, fully remote, with flexible weekly hours.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, partnering with leading AI research labs to advance frontier model capabilities in reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, and STEM. Our work directly shapes how next-generation AI systems solve mission-critical challenges across science, technology, and industry.

Role Overview:

We are seeking PhD-level Physics experts to contribute to cutting-edge AI research. As a Physics Expert – AI Trainer, you’ll design challenging problems, evaluate model outputs, and provide expert feedback to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs).

This is a remote, contract-based role with flexible weekly hour options (10, 20, or 30 hours per week).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and solve advanced physics problems across mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, quantum theory, and related domains.
  • Evaluate AI-generated solutions for scientific rigor, correctness, and clarity.
  • Provide structured, expert-level feedback that identifies model strengths, weaknesses, and misconceptions.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers to refine evaluation benchmarks and improve training workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation of physics-focused datasets that shape the frontier of AI performance.

Key Qualifications:

  • PhD or Postdoctoral (or currently enrolled) in Physics, Applied Physics, or closely related fields.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to solve complex, multi-step problems with clear reasoning.
  • Excellent written communication; able to explain advanced concepts simply and precisely.
  • Independent, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a remote research environment.
  • Reliable technical setup (computer + internet).

Why Join Turing?

  • Impact: Your expertise will directly influence how the world’s most advanced AI systems understand and reason about physics.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first role with weekly hour options tailored to your schedule.
  • Collaboration: Work alongside global experts and leading AI labs.
  • Career Growth: Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI research and future-proof your career at the intersection of physics and artificial intelligence.

Engagement Details:

  • Compensation: $50–$150 per hour, based on skills and experience. (paid once every two weeks).
  • Duration: 1 week to 3 months (project-based; extension possible).
  • Hours: Up to 30 hrs/week.
  • Time Zone: 2–5 hrs/day overlap with UTC-8 (America/Los_Angeles), confirmed near onboarding.

Selection: Task-based assessment for shortlisted candidates → contract offer.

title: Programador(a) Back-End - Unity/C#
description:
Local: Híbrido (Localidade Zona Oeste de São Paulo).

Contrato: CLT

Sobre a Oportunidade

Você irá atuar no desenvolvimento Back-End de soluções tecnológicas voltadas para o auxílio à navegação aquaviária, em um projeto inovador com colaboração internacional. Seu foco será na criação e manutenção de sistemas robustos e escaláveis, responsáveis pelo processamento de dados em tempo real, integração com módulos de geolocalização (GIS), lógica de negócio e comunicação com APIs e bancos de dados. A tecnologia será aplicada em ferramentas utilizadas por profissionais como práticos, operadores de empurradores e comboios fluviais, com o objetivo de melhorar a precisão, segurança e eficiência das operações nos rios e portos.

Neste papel, você fará parte de um time multidisciplinar e altamente técnico, desenvolvendo soluções baseadas em Unity e C#, com forte atuação no Back-End, incluindo suporte à análise de dados, controle de fluxos e integração entre sistemas. O projeto é conduzido com metodologias ágeis (Scrum), gestão de tarefas via ClickUp e versionamento de código com GitHub

Suas responsabilidades

  • Participar da revisão metodológica e na especificação de dados de entrada.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar algoritmos e software para processamento de dados.
  • Criar e manter APIs e interfaces de dados para integração entre sistemas.
  • Apoiar na integração de módulos, análise de dados e auto-monitoramento .
  • Contribuir na implementação em nível de sistema .
  • Participar do projeto e execução de casos de uso em cenários de simulação .
  • Realizar validação em ambiente relevante , garantindo estabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Trabalhar em equipe ágil (Scrum), com foco em entregas de qualidade.

O que buscamos

  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento Back-End .
  • Vivência com Unity/C# e integração de sistemas.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs, estruturas de dados e algoritmos .
  • Experiência em controle de versionamento (GitHub) .
  • Desejável experiência com Scrum e ferramentas de gestão como ClickUp .
  • Desejável conhecimento em Python, especialmente para automações, análise de dados ou scripts auxiliares.
  • Perfil proativo, analítico e orientado a soluções.
  • Diferencial: experiência com Cloud (Google Cloud) , sistemas GIS e processamento de dados complexos .
  • Parte da documentação do projeto será em inglês . Domínio da linguagem escrita e falada é fundamental.

O que oferecemos

  • Participação em um projeto internacional inovador.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e com autonomia de criação.
  • Flexibilidade de horário e possibilidade de trabalho Híbrido.
  • Remuneração compatível com experiência.

Sobre a Contratante

A Navigandi, fundada em 2019 como uma spin-off do Laboratório Tanque de Provas Numérico da Universidade de São Paulo (TPN-USP), é uma empresa inovadora dedicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções e equipamentos de auxílio à navegação. Com um forte foco em pesquisa e desenvolvimento, a Navigandi criou o Navigandi Orbis, a primeira Portable Pilot Unit (PPU) totalmente desenvolvida e fabricada nas Américas, e o Navigandi Tow, um sistema de navegação para empurradores e comboios fluviais. A empresa tem uma sólida parceria com a FAPESP e o TPN-USP, e suas soluções são amplamente utilizadas por práticos brasileiros em diversos portos nacionais. A Navigandi busca constantemente otimizar suas tecnologias e promover a segurança e eficiência na navegação aquaviária.

title: "Analista de Infraestrutura e suporte N2 # 968273"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

Objetivo do Cargo:

Atuar com infraestrutura de TI, oferecendo suporte de nível 1 e 2 em redes, desktops, notebooks e sistemas operacionais Windows. Responsável por gerenciar filas de ITSM, solucionar problemas de hardware e software, garantir conformidade de segurança e colaborar com melhorias contínuas da operação.

Responsabilidades:

Prestar suporte técnico local e remoto, especialmente a diretores e VPs.

Gerenciar tíquetes de hardware e coordenar com fornecedores.

Manter a operação em conformidade com diretrizes de segurança.

Elaborar e seguir procedimentos internos, gerando documentação e relatórios de backup.

Atuar proativamente para melhorar a qualidade dos serviços e reduzir incidentes.

Auxiliar na análise de expansão e melhorias de infraestrutura.

Requisitos:

Experiência em TI, com foco em ambientes Microsoft.

Atendimento e gerenciamento de chamados no Service Now (preferencialmente).

Gestão de documentação, ativos e normas.

Conhecimento em ITIL Foundation (obrigatório), Exchange e tecnologias híbridas.

Vivência prática com SAP e sistemas Microsoft (diferencial).

Inglês avançado

Soft skills:

Adaptabilidade e habilidade para lidar com públicos variados, incluindo alta liderança.
